description: This file defines an AutoRouter class for semantic routing in a machine learning application. It includes methods for loading routes from configuration, asynchronously altering routing decisions before processing requests, and integrates with other semantic routing components.

classes.name: AutoRouter
classes.description: Main class implementing an auto-routing strategy that uses semantic routing to select models based on input messages.
